# CNBC

> CNBC is the world's leading source for real-time financial market data, business news, and analysis covering stocks, bonds, commodities, and global economic trends.

CNBC provides comprehensive coverage of financial markets, corporate earnings, and economic policy from major central banks like the Federal Reserve and ECB. The site serves investors, business professionals, and general audiences seeking market updates, industry-specific news, and investigative journalism on corporate accountability.

## Key Topics

- Stock Markets & Indexes
- Federal Reserve & Monetary Policy
- Oil & Energy Markets
- Market Analysis
- Financial Earnings
- Geopolitics
- Electric Vehicles
- Tech Stocks
- Bonds & Yields
- Commodities
- M&A & Corporate News
- Market Movers
- Fed Policy
- Prediction Markets
- Business News

## Core Markets & Data

- [CNBC Homepage](https://www.cnbc.com): CNBC homepage: world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage
- [Markets: Indexes, Bonds, Forex, Key Commodities, ETFs](https://www.cnbc.com/markets): Live market data for S&P, NASDAQ, DOW, Treasury, and global market overview
- [Finance News](https://www.cnbc.com/finance): Finance and investing news from Wall Street covering stocks and market movers

## Business & Economics

- [Business News](https://www.cnbc.com/business): Business news hub covering corporate earnings, M&A, and market updates
- [Economic News](https://www.cnbc.com/economy): Economic news from Federal Reserve, ECB, BOE on rates, inflation, and GDP

## Energy & Commodities

- [Energy News](https://www.cnbc.com/energy): Energy market news on oil, gas, geopolitics, and global energy trends
- [Climate Change and Environment News](https://www.cnbc.com/climate): Climate, renewable energy, ESG, and clean tech business news coverage

## Industry Verticals

- [Healthcare & Science News](https://www.cnbc.com/health-and-science): Healthcare news covering FDA approvals, pharma industry, and biotech stocks
- [Transportation News: Airlines, Autos, Roads and Rails](https://www.cnbc.com/transportation): Transportation industry news on airlines, autos, EVs, and logistics
- [Media News](https://www.cnbc.com/media): Media industry news on Disney, Paramount, streaming, and M&A deals
- [Real Estate News](https://www.cnbc.com/real-estate): Real estate coverage of housing markets, mortgages, and home affordability

## Emerging & Alternative Markets

- [Prediction Markets](https://www.cnbc.com/prediction-markets): News and insights on Polymarket, Kalshi, and prediction market regulation

## Investigations & Analysis

- [CNBC Investigations](https://www.cnbc.com/cnbc-investigations): In-depth investigative journalism on corporate accountability and fraud
